response.overview: Solar Roots - the Pioneers of PV is a documentary film that tells the true story of the birth of an industry. This non-commercial free-to-the-world film was created by Jeff Spies and Jason Vetterli with the help and assistance of dozens of member of the Solar Family. Our organic low budget documentary style was a deliberate approach to the story telling resulting in a quirky, humorous movie which has received widespread support from solar pioneers and industry professionals alike.
response.tagline: the true story of the birth of an industry.
response.title: Solar Roots
